referrals.need: I need financing or an SBA loan
referrals.note: Three member banks. Ask more than one, because small business lending appetites differ more than the rates do.

referrals.need: I need to check my coverage
referrals.note: Worth a review if your coverage predates a build-out or a change in headcount.

referrals.need: I need help with taxes or bookkeeping
referrals.note: The chamber has no accountant or CPA in membership, so there is nobody to point you at. If you are one, this category is open and it is the most asked-for referral the chamber cannot fill.
No attorney in membership either. Another open category.

referrals.need: I need to hire, fire, or write a handbook
referrals.note: Works with employers too small to staff an HR person.

referrals.need: I need space, or I am building something
referrals.note: Commercial property, development, and the engineering side of a build.

referrals.need: I need to be seen by more people
referrals.note: Media and marketing, including the local publications members already read.

referrals.need: I need somewhere to hold an event
referrals.note: Where the monthly luncheon and the golf tournament happen.
